data.body: Investigation complete (MODE: investigation-only inline pass). Root cause confirmed: process_link() in _processors.py stores LINK target verbatim without alias resolution. Fix: pass tracker_dir through replay_events to process_link; call resolve_ticket_id() before storing; graceful fallback for unresolvable targets. RED test: test_reducer_link_event_alias_target_normalizes_to_canonical_uuid. Scratch key: fix-bug:investigation.
